cover.verdict: Open, and cheaper than Norway, but crowded at the top. Burgers are taken, pizza and café chains are failing, and the live window is takeaway-led fast food while takeaway VAT stays at 6% to the end of 2027.

market.headline: Rich, price-aware and top-heavy, and fast food is the segment that is growing
market.intro: Sweden has the spending power, and consumer confidence is at its highest since December 2021. Growth is going to fast food, not to the seated restaurant, so the brands that win sell a full basket quickly and cheaply.

tiles.label: POPULATION
tiles.body: 10,621,103 in August 2026, up 0.15% on year-end 2025. Growth has almost stalled. Stockholm county holds 23.5% of residents, so entry usually means Stockholm first.

tiles.label: GDP PER HEAD
tiles.body: 2025, against EUR 41,770 for the EU27: about 135% of the average (Estimate: simple division). About £47,100 at the Riksbank rate of 23 Oct (Estimate). The 2025 figure may still be provisional.

tiles.label: FOOD-SERVICE SPEND
tiles.body: Household spend on restaurants and accommodation in 2025 (Estimate: four quarters added), up 5.2% in value. Volume grew 2.5% in Q2 2026. Restaurant turnover alone was SEK 160.7bn in 2024.

tiles.label: FRANCHISE COUNT
tiles.body: There is no official count. The association claims more than SEK 300bn of turnover and 150,000 jobs, wording it has repeated since 2020. A directory says about 800 systems and 35,000 franchisees, with no year.

tiles.label: CONSUMER SPENDING
tiles.body: Real household consumption growth in Q2 2026. Confidence reached 102.2 in September, the highest since December 2021. Restaurant prices rose 2.2% in the year to September, against 1.1% for everything.

tiles.label: CURRENCY · SEK
tiles.body: €1 = SEK 11.13 and $1 = SEK 9.94 on 23 Oct 2026. The Riksbank held its rate at 1.75% and says rises should begin this year. The next decision is published on 4 Nov 2026.

market.sowhat: Margins are thin: restaurants kept about 6 crowns of operating profit per 100 sold in 2024 (5.7%, Estimate), and the median restaurant spends 36% of turnover on staff. Fast food volume is up 5.6% while seated lunch and evening restaurants are down 0.8%, so a concept that sells a quick, full basket has room. A labour-heavy seated format does not. [{{nace56}}, {{visitamom}}, {{visq2}}]

rising.headline: Fast food and chicken are growing. Pizza and café chains are failing, and burgers are full.
rising.intro: A rise or fall call needs two independent signals. Where we found only one, the row is marked Thin. We could make only two dated store-locator counts; the rest are company reports, press or brand claims, and the row says which.

rows.evidence: KFC reached 24 sites by Oct 2025 (company-reported, not a locator count), and its Stockholm-area count doubled in 2024. Loco Chicken, from Germany, announced its first Swedish site in Lund for 5 Sep 2026 (we did not confirm it opened). No Popeyes or Wingstop found.

MAX Sweden went from 147 sites (end 2022) to 150 to 163 (end 2025). McDonald's passed 200 sites in Nov 2025 with 7 openings planned that year. Five Guys opened in 2025 and had 3 sites by Apr 2026. Burger King's "over 100" is a brand claim, against 113–114 in older sources.

Pizza Hut went from 25 restaurants (Nov 2025) to bankruptcy on 9 Sep 2026, with 18 closed. Domino's has 15 stores (counted 24 Oct 2026; 3 flagged closed; none in Stockholm) against 14 in Jun 2024, but staff went unpaid on 25 Sep 2026 and the operator reports a dispute with Domino's.

No two independent time series. Holy Kebab has 8 sites (counted 24 Oct 2026). Sibylla, the hot-dog and grill chain, has about 120 outlets per press; its only earlier count ("a couple of hundred", 2010) is on a different basis, so no direction can be drawn. A current German Doner Kebab count: Not found.

Espresso House's Swedish coffee shops fell from 253 (end 2023) to 238 to 216 (end 2025), and its Swedish headcount from 3,714 (2022) to 2,878 (2024). Wayne's Coffee went from 90 cafés (2017) to 58, and its franchisor was declared bankrupt on 4 Jul 2026.
Fabrique went from about 20 to 22 sites in Sweden over about 3.5 years (Thin). Café volume was down 3.9% in Q1 2024 and up 5.0% in Q2 2026. No international dessert chain found.
A blog claimed "over 60" shops in 2022 and named no chain. We found no international chain and no counts. Demand data: Not found.

Fast food volume was up 5.6% in H1 2026, while lunch and evening restaurants fell 0.8%. Pinchos has over 60 Swedish sites and is for sale. Taco Bell opened its first site on 27 Nov 2025. Against that, Vapiano entered reconstruction in Jan 2025, and Brödernas had about 70 restaurants at its Oct 2024 reconstruction, with 33 subsidiaries bankrupt by Mar 2025.
Oatly's Europe revenue rose 21% in Q2 2026 and MAX has a 14-item green menu. We found no plant-based restaurant chain and no Swedish grocery trend.

Traffic-adjacent volume rose 5.0% and fast food 6.3% in Q2 2026. Takeaway VAT is 6% against 12% eating in until 31 Dec 2027. Sibylla is being bought to reach 200+ outlets. The tailwinds are temporary.

reading.title: Growth follows speed and takeaway
paras: Fast food volume rose **5.6%** in the first half of 2026, and lunch and evening restaurants fell **0.8%**. The growth is at the quick, takeaway-friendly end: MAX, McDonald's, Pinchos, Sibylla. [S{{visq2}}]

Pizza and coffee chains are **failing or shrinking**: Pizza Hut is bankrupt, Wayne's franchisor is bankrupt, and Espresso House closed 37 Swedish shops in two years. [S{{phbk}}, S{{wayne}}, S{{espresso}}]
Chicken has **one scaled player**. KFC runs 24 sites through one Nordic operator, with a German challenger just arriving. [S{{kfc}}, S{{loco}}]

white.headline: Four gaps worth a closer look, and one has a deadline
white.intro: A gap is a need with growing demand and no clear owner. The size of each one is our judgement of the prize for a new entrant: S, M or L.

gaps.title: Takeaway-first fast food
gaps.gap: Takeaway pays half the VAT of a seated meal until the end of 2027, and fast food is the one segment growing fast. The scaled players are burgers and hot dogs, so a takeaway-first format in other cuisines is open.
gaps.evidence: Fast food volume +5.6% in H1 2026 and traffic-adjacent +5.0% in Q2. Takeaway VAT 6% against 12% eating in. Sibylla changed hands to chase 200+ outlets. [S{{visq2}}, S{{vat}}, S{{sibyllaDeal}}]
gaps.suits: Small-box and drive-thru formats with a simple menu and strong takeaway sales.
gaps.route: Master franchise, or area developer with a Nordic QSR operator.
gaps.sizeText: before takeaway VAT returns to 12%, 1 Jan 2028

gaps.title: The second chicken brand
gaps.gap: One scaled chicken chain, KFC, and one newcomer. Nobody holds the second rung.
gaps.evidence: KFC reached 24 sites by Oct 2025. Loco Chicken announced Lund for 5 Sep 2026 (opening unconfirmed). No Popeyes or Wingstop found. [S{{kfc}}, S{{loco}}]
gaps.suits: International chicken brands with multi-country franchise systems.
gaps.route: Master franchise with a Nordic multi-brand operator.

gaps.title: Mexican and Asian fast casual
gaps.gap: International brands are only now testing niche cuisines in Sweden.
gaps.evidence: Taco Bell opened its first Swedish site on 27 Nov 2025 through franchisee TB Group Scandinavia. Pinchos has over 60 sites. Sticks'n'Sushi is due in spring 2027 (Thin). [S{{tacobell}}, S{{pinchos}}]
gaps.suits: Compact fast-casual concepts with a franchise-ready manual.
gaps.route: Master franchise with a local operator, or area developer.

gaps.title: Bubble tea and treat drinks
gaps.gap: A trend category with independents but no branded chain.
gaps.evidence: Only independents found, and no international chain present. Demand data: Not found. [S{{bobatea}}]
gaps.route: Master franchise, or direct franchise with one strong Stockholm partner.

matrix.intro: Our assessment from the page 3 evidence. Position is judgement, not measurement.
matrix.note: Bakery and dessert are left off: mixed signals, too little data to place. Source: WRW Hospitality analysis of the page 3 evidence.

position.quote: If I ran a takeaway-led fast food brand right now, I'd be in a Swedish master-franchise conversation before the takeaway VAT window closes.
paras: Takeaway pays half the VAT of a seated meal until the end of 2027, fast food is the one segment growing fast, and the chain deals are changing hands. The brand in early gets the sites before the rate goes back to 12%.
If I ran a pizza or coffee brand, I'd look elsewhere. Pizza Hut is bankrupt, Wayne's franchisor is bankrupt, and Espresso House is closing shops.

regulation.headline: A disclosure law, a firm wage floor, and a VAT split that rewards takeaway
regulation.intro: Sweden is easier to enter than Norway on paper and cheaper to run, but not cheap. The law protects the franchisee with disclosure, so write your pack well. The wage agreement does most of the cost, so model it first.

rows.text: **A disclosure duty, no registration.** Lag (2006:484) requires written information in good time before signing, covering 8 listed areas. A court can order it, with a fine. We found no proposals for change.

File with PRV: SEK 2,700 for one class online (SEK 3,900 otherwise), SEK 1,000 per extra class. About 6 weeks to a first answer, then a 3-month opposition period. **An EU trade mark covers Sweden;** a UK mark does not.

Register the food business with the municipality before opening; you may start 2 weeks after a complete notice. Fees are set locally (examples SEK 1,200 to 2,200). **There is no national inspection rating scheme.**
The municipality grants the licence. Application fees found were about SEK 11,000 to 11,900, plus an annual supervision fee. **The food and own-kitchen requirement was removed on 1 Jun 2026.**

Animals must be stunned before slaughter, so unstunned halal is banned. We found no import ban or quota on halal meat (Thin). EU packaging rules apply from 12 Aug 2026 and the deforestation rules from 30 Dec 2026.

VAT is 6% on food including takeaway until 31 Dec 2027, and 12% eating in. Corporate tax is 20.6%. The UK–Sweden treaty gives 0% on royalties; get advice on whether an initial fee counts as a royalty.

An AB needs SEK 25,000 share capital and a SEK 2,700 fee. Half the board and the managing director must live in the EEA, unless Bolagsverket grants an exemption. Restaurants also need a staff ID ledger and a certified cash register.

route.headline: Pick the route that fits your size. Then price the risk.
route.intro: Each route trades control against capital and speed. The examples below show how brands have actually come into Sweden, and how some have left.

routes.name: Master franchise
routes.seen: KFC via Nordic Service Partners: 24 sites in about 10 years. Subway signed a Nordic master franchise with Nordic Bites on 20 May 2025, targeting 250 new sites by 2032. Taco Bell via TB Group Scandinavia (Nov 2025). Domino's was sold with 14 stores for EUR 2m in 2021. [S{{kfc}}, S{{subway}}, S{{tacobell}}, S{{dom2021}}]

routes.name: Area developer
routes.seen: Subway's 2010 development agreement for Finland and Sweden became the four-country master in 2025. One example found. [S{{subway}}]

routes.name: Direct franchise
routes.seen: Domestic chains growing this way: Pinchos (over 60 Swedish sites, says over 80% franchised) and Sibylla (about 120 outlets, sold for SEK 1 to chase 200+). Wayne's franchisor went bankrupt in Jul 2026. [S{{pinchos}}, S{{sibyllaDeal}}, S{{wayne}}]

routes.name: Company-owned launch
routes.seen: MAX owns 199 of 203 sites, 163 in Sweden. Brödernas expanded fast, then entered reconstruction in Oct 2024. Five Guys had 3 sites after about 2 years (structure unverified). [S{{maxfull}}, S{{broder}}, S{{fiveguys2}}]

fits.label: EMERGING BRAND
fits.title: Master franchise
fits.body: Under c. 25 units and no overseas track record. A Swedish multi-site operator brings the wage, licence and property know-how you can't buy remotely. KFC took about 10 years to reach 24 sites, so plan a slow ramp.

fits.label: MID-SIZE BRAND
fits.title: Direct, with one anchor partner
fits.body: Proven in 2 countries. The domestic winners, Pinchos and Sibylla, grew by direct franchising, but both franchisors have changed hands, so protect your standards in the contract.

fits.label: GLOBAL BRAND
fits.title: Nordic master partner
fits.body: Subway chose one Nordic master for four countries in 2025. Back a partner who can take Sweden and its neighbours.

route.riskTitle: Price the risk before you price the franchise

risks.label: COSTS AND DEMAND
risks.body: Restaurant prices rose 2.7% in the year to Aug 2026, and volume is still 1.2% below its Q2 2022 peak. Operating margin was 5.7% in 2024. Bankruptcies have fallen for four quarters, but chains keep failing.

risks.label: LABOUR
risks.body: A wage floor of SEK 153.64 an hour and about 54% on-costs. The median restaurant spends 36% of turnover on staff. The agreement ends 31 Mar 2027, so talks fall inside your first year.

risks.label: SUPPLY CHAIN
risks.body: MAX buys only Swedish beef in Sweden, and beef is 55% of its climate impact, so protein origin and cost are the exposure. Grocery prices fell in 2026. Meat and dairy import data: Not found.

risks.label: SEASONALITY
risks.body: Q2 sales run about 23% above Q1 (Estimate). Summer 2025 had 30.8m accommodation nights, 9.4m by foreign guests. No Swedish winter figure found.

risks.label: REGULATORY
risks.body: Takeaway VAT returns to 12% on 1 Jan 2028 unless extended. The lower youth contribution ends 30 Sep 2027. EU packaging rules reach takeaway in 2027 and 2028.

risks.label: CURRENCY AND RATES
risks.body: Royalties paid in SEK are worth less in sterling after a weaker krona. The Riksbank is at 1.75% and expects to start raising the rate this year, which lifts franchisee borrowing costs.

days.headline: Ten moves, in order, before you sign anything
moves: **File your trade mark** with PRV or EUIPO now. An EU mark covers Sweden; a UK mark does not.
**Prepare the written disclosure pack** the franchise law requires, in good time before anyone signs.
**Rebuild the unit P&L** at Swedish wages, with about 54% on-costs on top of pay.
**Model both VAT rates:** 6% takeaway, 12% eating in, and the return to 12% on 1 Jan 2028.
**Shortlist 3 to 5 Nordic multi-brand operators** as master or area partners.
**Count the competition yourself,** with dated store-locator counts for KFC, MAX, Burger King and Espresso House.
**Choose your first cluster:** Stockholm for spend, or Gothenburg and Malmö for lower rents.
**Plan the licence path:** municipal food registration, plus an alcohol licence if needed.
**Map local supply** for meat and dairy, and the packaging rules from 2027.
**Agree how royalties are paid** and hedged in SEK.
check: Dated store-locator counts for KFC, MAX, Burger King, McDonald's, Espresso House and Bastard Burgers
The volume effect of the takeaway VAT cut (we found the price effect only)
Bolagsverket registration time, and alcohol and food fees in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö
Whether a franchisee must sign the collective agreement, and how an initial fee is taxed
Current counts for Subway, Sushi Yama, Pinchos and Sibylla

Not legal, tax or investment advice.
